'''''The Sy Snootles Show''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] advertisement for a series of [[Music/Legends|music]] concerts of concerts of the same name. They showed the singer [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]]<ref name="Deception" /> and read:<ref name="SW-Deception Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/deception-trivia-gallery|text="Deception" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref>

{{ScrollBox|<center><poem><big>[[The Sy Snootles Show/Legends|THE SY SNOOTLES SHOW]]</big>
<small>STARRING</small>
IN PERSON
<big><big><big>SY
SNOOTLES</big></big></big>
<big><big><big><big>SOLD OUT</big></big></big></big>
<small>''[gibberish]''</small>
THE [[Color/Legends|BLUE]] GUYS
SOME RED [[Gender/Legends|DUDES]]
PURPLE PEOPLE
<big><big>SOMEWHERE ON [[Coruscant/Legends|CORUSCANT]]</big></big>
<small>OVER HERE – OVER THERE</small>
<big><big>[[Friday/Legends|FRI]]–[[Saturday/Legends|SAT]] 12–4</big></big>
<small>MATINEE AND NIGHT SNOWS</small></poem></center>}}

The poster was put up in the back room of [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]], a shady [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]];<ref name="Deception" /> in a [[Unidentified Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]]<ref name="Revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref> commandeered by [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]];<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref> and in an alley in the settlement of [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]] on [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]].<ref name="Missing in Action">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>
